functions.name: accept_goods
functions.doc: Buyer's wallet pays the exact price: goods go to the buyer and NEAR to the seller, atomically.

functions.name: buy_charter
functions.doc:
Buy a listed charter. The caller (the buyer's merchant wallet) attaches the price;
 the NEAR goes to the treasury and the NFT moves to the caller in the same transaction.

functions.name: cancel_goods
functions.doc: Seller reclaims goods from an offer nobody accepted.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: list_charter
functions.doc: List a charter for sale (a bankruptcy seizure, or a buyout the owner agreed to).

functions.name: migrate
functions.doc: One-time upgrade from v2 state: keeps every charter, balance and listing and adds the offers map.

functions.name: mint_charter
functions.doc:
Mint a merchant charter. The merchant's wallet is a separate NEAR account
 (normally `<slug>.<vizier>`) that holds the business's working capital.

functions.name: sync_goods
functions.doc: Vizier mirrors trades with suppliers/townsfolk: sets exact balances, minting or burning the difference.

functions.name: takeover
functions.doc:
A bankrupt charter is bought: the NFT moves to the buyer's owner account and is
 recorded as absorbed by the buyer's charter. Payment for the charter is settled
 wallet-to-wallet by the game in a separate NEAR transfer.
